OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type

          type: string
          format: uri

        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          title: Timestamp

          pattern: '.*\S.*'

## Summary

I implemented optional owner `email` — validated syntactically, stored and returned lower-cased — with minimal structural impact. Changes touched 4 files and added no complexity to any existing method:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added an `email` property (`format: email`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. The OpenAPI generator emits `@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email` + `@Size(max=255)` on the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`, so an invalid address (`"not-an-email"`) is rejected by Bean Validation with **400** before reaching the service, while a missing email is accepted. `OwnerDto` inherits the field for responses.

2. **`Owner.java`** (model) — added the `email` field plus a trivial `getEmail()` and a `setEmail()` that lower-cases via `Locale.ROOT`. Normalizing in the setter means both the MapStruct create-mapping and the persisted/returned value are canonical, with no change to the existing mapper or controller.

3. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** — added the `email VARCHAR(255)` column to `owners` (the profile the test suite uses).

4. **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — appended a `NULL` email to the 10 positional seed inserts so their column counts still match.

Design notes:
- I put normalization in the entity setter rather than adding a new MapStruct qualifier (as telephone does) specifically to avoid editing the mapper file and to keep the change to *added* accessors only — no existing method grew, and MapStruct maps `email` automatically by name.
- I updated only the **hsqldb** schema/data (the test profile). The main app runs on the **h2** profile with `ddl-auto=update`, which adds the column automatically. If you deploy on the **postgres/mysql** profiles, their `schema.sql` files would also need the `email` column added — let me know and I'll extend those too.
